title: HTTP dissector memory management tweaks
description:
Replace `wmem_packet_scope()` calls with `pinfo->pool` as per [this
request][1] by @eapache.

Remove `stat_info` as an "ugly global variable." Turn it into
packet-scoped protocol data, so it's available to any caller with a
`packet_info *` argument.

Add a `packet_info *` or `wmem_allocator_t *` argument to function calls
which need them.

[1]: https://www.wireshark.org/lists/wireshark-dev/202107/msg00052.html
